segments.he: הַהוּא בֵּי שִׁמְשָׁא אֲתַאי שִׁבָבְתָּא, קָא קָרְיָה אַבָּבָא, אֲמַרָה אַמְּתֵיהּ: שְׁתִיקוּ, דְּרַבִּי יָתֵיב. כֵּיוָן דִּשְׁמַע, שׁוּב לָא אֲתָא, שֶׁלֹּא לְהוֹצִיא לַעַז עַל צַדִּיקִים הָרִאשׁוֹנִים.
segments.en: The Gemara relates the following incident: It happened on «a certain Shabbat eve» that a «neighbor came» by and «called» and knocked «at the door. His maidservant said» to her: «Be quiet, for Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «is sitting. When he heard» his maidservant reveal his presence to the neighbor, «he did not come again, so as not to cast aspersions on earlier righteous» individuals who did not appear to their families following their death.

moves.summary: A neighbor knocked; the maid hushed her since Rabbi was present; Rabbi stopped coming
